instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's choice: 'B: The Passage, with C's prints' for homepage visual narrative.
Do NOT create a generic developer résumé or skills list section (no React/Node tags or progress bars).
Show three distinct product stars: StayEase, StockPilot (concept screens), Splitfin (MOBILE-ONLY, no desktop frame!).
Implement real working React UI mockups inside custom browser and phone frame components.
Splitfin product page MUST feature a fully interactive tappable mobile phone prototype with bill split calculator.
All navigation links and action buttons MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-stayease-link').
Ensure header/navigation bar is visible with subtle backdrop blur and non-transparent background.
Include WebGL fallback support and prefers-reduced-motion check so performance remains fast on all devices.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain gradients.
Use 2-3x generous spacing with explicit padding inside bordered containers.
All interactive elements must have micro-interactions (hover states, click states, focus indicators).
DO NOT use emojis as UI icons. Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react icons.
Ensure color contrast meets APCA / WCAG standards.
All interactive elements MUST contain data-testid attributes.
